instruction: Please act as a professional Verilog designer. Create a module that accumulates input data serially and outputs the accumulation results every 4 input data. The module should have two input ports, one for the 8-bit input data and the other for the valid signal. The output ports should include the valid and ready signals for both upstream and downstream communication, as well as a 10-bit output port for the accumulation results. The module should be designed using a counter and a multiplexer to achieve the desired functionality. The module must ensure that data transmission is smooth without any bubble and without any additional performance loss due to the design of the module.
label: clean
